questions.question: Using the data in Extract B, calculate the relative unit labour cost percentage change. Show your working.
questions.modelAnswer: Formula: ((New Value - Original Value) / Original Value) * 100. Correct substitution yields the percentage shift.
questions.reasoning: 1 mark formula identification, 2 marks working steps, 1 mark correct final numerical output.
